business_summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited engages in the manufacture, trading, and provision of services for specialty chemicals products in India. It offers a range of chemicals, equipment systems, and technical services for total water management and water reuse across industrial, commercial, and institutional sectors. The company also provides concrete additives, joint sealants, cement-based ready-to-use tile adhesives and repair mortars, waterproofing solutions, and curing compounds. In addition, it offers industrial and institutional hygiene solutions, such as cleaning and sanitation products to the food, beverage, dairy, institutional, and hospitality sectors. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
